purpose: Starting roles; every actual instance must declare allowed and unsupported input behaviors.

profiles.conflict: Do not submit twice after long press or pointer cancellation.

profiles.longPress: optional explanation if visible alternative exists
profiles.alternative: visible accessible name and keyboard action
profiles.conflict: Tooltip must not hide focus or capture click.

profiles.dragDrop: unsupported as product action by default
profiles.conflict: Do not replace link with a click-only div.
A drag gesture on thumb is not required for switching.

profiles.keyboard: Tab to active tab; arrows among tabs
profiles.conflict: Dragging for tab order must not conflict with selecting a tab.

profiles.dragDrop: unsupported unless asset management task exists
profiles.alternative: viewer previous/next buttons and scoped arrows
profiles.conflict: Touch users must see the open action without hover.

profiles.keyboard: Tab among controls; arrows change image; Escape closes
profiles.conflict: Scoped keys while open; restore opener focus when closed.

profiles.dragDrop: optional slide drag if product requires
profiles.keyboard: Tab controls; picker arrows only when tab pattern
profiles.alternative: visible previous/next buttons and single-pointer activation
profiles.conflict: Swipe or drag must not be sole navigation; stop auto rotation on focus.

profiles.clickTap: only if entire card owns one action; otherwise child controls
profiles.longPress: optional context action with visible menu alternative
profiles.dragDrop: optional only for explicit movable-card variant
profiles.keyboard: Tab to owned action or child controls
profiles.alternative: same select or move action via buttons/menu
profiles.conflict: Nested button clicks must not also activate card.

profiles.clickTap: open/select or use separate child actions
profiles.longPress: optional context menu with visible alternative
profiles.keyboard: Tab to action; reorder control if present
profiles.alternative: move up/down buttons or destination picker
profiles.conflict: Swipe, long press and row tap need distinct state transitions.

profiles.clickTap: enter move mode or expose move controls
profiles.longPress: optional start of drag on touch
profiles.keyboard: Tab; move mode or up/down controls; Escape cancel
profiles.conflict: Movement threshold separates tap from drag; pointercancel rolls back.

profiles.dragDrop: optional file drop onto named zone
profiles.alternative: file picker is available without drag
profiles.conflict: Validate file type/size for both picker and drop.

profiles.clickTap: set value from track when supported
profiles.keyboard: Tab to thumb; arrows change value
profiles.alternative: track click/tap or numeric input without dragging
profiles.conflict: Drag must not steal unrelated page scrolling.

profiles.longPress: optional touch context menu with visible trigger
profiles.dragDrop: optional row/column reorder when explicitly designed
profiles.keyboard: Tab into grid; arrows among cells; Enter/F2 edit
profiles.alternative: move command or controls if reorder is supported
profiles.conflict: Drag, text selection and cell editing need separate modes.

profiles.longPress: optional context tool with visible trigger
profiles.dragDrop: optional object movement if task requires
profiles.keyboard: tool controls plus keyboard movement or form alternative
profiles.alternative: single-pointer controls for zoom/pan and non-drag operation
profiles.conflict: Preserve scrolling unless explicit active canvas tool owns gesture.

profiles.dragDrop: optional drag handle to resize or dismiss
profiles.keyboard: Tab through controls; Escape when dismissible
profiles.alternative: visible close and size controls if drag changes essential state
profiles.conflict: Drag handle must not capture scrolling of sheet content.

profiles.keyboard: Tab; Enter/Space open; arrows in menu
profiles.conflict: Opening menu is not a drag gesture.

profiles.clickTap: select, remove or open according to explicit variant
profiles.dragDrop: optional only for reorderable token variant
profiles.conflict: Selected state, remove action and focus are separate.
